title: DOW-UAP-D079, Narrative Statement 1, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: A first-hand narrative statement from a federal law enforcement witness describing observations of unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) over two days in October 2023 in the western United States.
interpretation_warnings: No body text was extractable from the PDF — all facts derive solely from metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
